ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure has a circle marked with V as the center, and the four vertices W, X, Y, Z of quadrilateral WXYZ are all on the circle, so WXYZ is a cyclic quadrilateral. The interior angle 95° is marked at vertex W in the figure, and vertex Y is the angle required; 60° is also marked at vertex Z, but it is not necessary to use it to find angle Y in this problem. Then reason: Because WXYZ is a cyclic quadrilateral, its opposite angles are supplementary. ∠W and ∠Y are a pair of opposite angles, therefore m∠W + m∠Y = 180°. Given m∠W = 95°, so m∠Y = 180° - 95° = 85°.
